profile.name: Azucena
profile.overview: Azucena, the Peruvian coffee queen, is a simple, stance-oriented mixup character who thrives off of entering her Libertador (LIB) and Backturn (BT) stances to attack her opponents. Both stances have a diverse set of mixup options, frame traps and pressure tools that allow Azucena to maximize her damage from stance entries in a variety of ways. She can also trick her opponent using the stances' parries and built-in movement options to dance around them.
profile.playstyle: Stance mix-ups with simple inputs. Get into Libertador (LIB) or Backturn (BT) and force guesses, use her i10 wall-splat punisher (1,2) to start pressure, and watch for LIB's auto-parry. Her strings mostly end in duckable highs, so do not finish them every time.
strengths: Simple inputs and easy to use stance moves.
Amazing 10 frame wallsplating punisher to setup stance mixups or keep pressure going.
Vast amount of wallsplating moves giving easy access to her devastating oki setups at the wall.
Great heat engagers that can be used in multiple ways; punishment, mixups, pressure, counter hits and to shut down sidestepping.
Good set of panic and evasive moves to escape pressure and stance mixups (e.g., f+1+2, db+3+4)
weaknesses: Strings have very limited follow-ups, with most exclusively only having duckable highs.
Slow and telling recovery makes her keepout risky and an easy target for whiff punishment.

stances.name: Libertador
stances.note: Her main stance: LIB.2 is a Heat Engager, LIB.1+2 tornadoes, LIB.4,1,2 is her combo ender. Libertador auto-parries some attacks while you move in, more in Heat (Wavu).

stances.name: Backturn
stances.note: Backturned mix-ups: BT.1,2 is another i10 splat punisher and BT.1+2 launches on counter hit (Wavu).

heat: During libertador in heat: Powered up auto-parries, new move (LIB.d+3+4), parries and walking forwards or sideways regains heat

keyMoves.summary: i10 punisher that wall-splats (Wavu: i10 splat).
keyMoves.purpose: Her best fast punish: damage plus wall splat.
keyMoves.use: After blocking -10 moves, especially near the wall.
keyMoves.counterplay: Duck the second hit if it is high when you are not being punished.
keyMoves.gamePlan: Learn this first: Wavu calls it an amazing 10-frame punisher.

keyMoves.purpose: Fast interrupt that recovers 2 frames faster.
keyMoves.use: To check and keep the turn up close.
To stop ducking and low pokes.
keyMoves.gamePlan: Use it so the opponent cannot duck her highs.

keyMoves.summary: Mount Rainier: i15 launcher, launches crouching too. -13 on block.

keyMoves.use: After blocking lows that are -15 or worse.
keyMoves.gamePlan: Punish every big low you block.

keyMoves.use: After -11 lows; to poke from crouch.
keyMoves.gamePlan: Wavu notes her crouch punishes are weak: use what is fast.

keyMoves.summary: Boomerang Scythe: i15 high, launches on counter hit (+56a), crushes some lows.
keyMoves.use: When you expect the opponent to press.

keyMoves.summary: Rodilla Shot: i17 knee, launches on counter hit (+59a), -5 on block.
keyMoves.use: At mid range when they press.
keyMoves.avoid: Expecting damage on normal hit: only +5.

keyMoves.summary: Hand Drip Hammer: i20 mid, +4 on block.
keyMoves.purpose: A plus-on-block mid that spikes on counter hit.
keyMoves.use: To keep the turn and set up stance mix-ups.
keyMoves.avoid: As a fast interrupt: it is i20.

keyMoves.summary: Bitter Low Kick: i19 low, -14 on block, +12g on counter hit.
Tacón Plunger: i19 mid Heat Engager, +2c on block.
Golpe Cappuccino: i14 mid from LIB, Heat Engager, -8 on block.
keyMoves.purpose: Her fast LIB mid and Heat Engager.
keyMoves.use: From Libertador when the opponent presses.
keyMoves.gamePlan: The mid side of her LIB mix-up.

keyMoves.summary: El Dorado Neck Snap: i12 throw, break with 1 or 2, side switch.
keyMoves.purpose: A throw with a side switch.

combos.name: Launch BnB: d+2,3 LIB.4,1,2 T! f+2,1,4
combos.situation: After a regular launch such as df+2 (Wavu: 61 damage).
mistakes: Pressing LIB.4 before the stance has started after d+2,3.
Rushing f+2,1,4 after the tornado: let them fall a little.
